chapters.title: Start at the recordings hub
chapters.text: This is the starting point for teaching session recordings and coaching meetings. Choose the workspace you want to review.

chapters.title: Tutor session recordings
chapters.text: Choose Tutor session recordings to find lectures, recordings and attendance. Browse by calendar date or LMS module.

chapters.title: Open the tutor workspace
chapters.text: Select the tutor card to open the lecture calendar. Search for a lecture, then open its details to review the available evidence.

chapters.title: Coach meetings and recordings
chapters.text: Choose Coach meetings and recordings to review meetings by coach, including available recordings, attendance and quality checks.

chapters.title: Choose a coach first
chapters.text: In the coaching workspace, choose a Coach to load their meeting calendar. The Coach meetings guide explains the next steps.

chapters.title: Find teaching session recordings
chapters.text: This page brings together lectures linked to LMS modules. Choose a calendar view or browse the module directory to find a session.

chapters.title: Choose a calendar view
chapters.text: Use the View buttons to switch between Day, Work week, Week and Month. Select Week to see teaching sessions across the selected week. The small calendar lets you choose a date.

chapters.title: Search for a lecture
chapters.text: Enter part of a lecture title, module or programme name. Use the results to find the session you need quickly.

chapters.title: Filter the recording library
chapters.text: Choose the programme and recording status beside the search box. All recordings includes every status. Open More filters to refine the cohort, group and module, or include draft programmes and archived modules.

chapters.title: Open lecture details
chapters.text: Select a lecture in the calendar to open the details drawer on the right. Review the date, time, programme, module and week. Scroll inside the drawer to reach the transcript, attendance and teaching quality check.

chapters.title: Play or download a recording
chapters.text: For a ready recording, use Play to watch the video or Download to save it. Files that are not ready display their current status.

chapters.title: Review attendance
chapters.text: Open View attendance and saved files to check learner names, time in the session and attendance status. Download attendance sheet exports the register.

chapters.title: Find transcripts and teaching quality checks
chapters.text: Open Transcript to access the available transcript tools. Use Open teaching quality check to start a review of the teaching session.

chapters.title: Browse by LMS module
chapters.text: Select All LMS modules, then expand a module to see its weeks and recordings. This provides another way to locate a teaching session.

chapters.title: Return to the calendar
chapters.text: Select Calendar to return to the date view. Find a session and review its recording and attendance before starting a quality check.

chapters.title: Choose the coach
chapters.text: Open the Coach menu and select a name. Use Search coaches or search within the menu to find a coach. The meeting calendar loads after you choose the coach whose meetings you want to review.

chapters.title: Choose the calendar period
chapters.text: Use Calendar period to choose Day, Week or Month. Select Week to review meetings across the selected week.

chapters.title: Filter by meeting status
chapters.text: Ready to action focuses on meetings ready for review. Choose All meetings to include every loaded meeting that matches the other filters.

chapters.title: Choose a meeting type
chapters.text: Meeting type separates monthly coaching, progress reviews, student support and other meetings. Select MCM to focus on monthly coaching meetings.

chapters.title: Filter by learner and LMS match
chapters.text: Learner narrows the results to one person. Match describes the link to an LMS booking. The time zone controls how meeting times are displayed.

chapters.title: Open the meeting
chapters.text: Select a meeting card in the calendar to open the details drawer on the right. Use its tabs to switch between Overview, Recording, Attendance, Transcript and Quality check. Close the drawer to return to the calendar.

chapters.title: Check the meeting information
chapters.text: In Overview, review the date, time, coach, learners and meeting type before assessing the session.

chapters.title: Review recording parts
chapters.text: Recording lists the available saved parts. Use Play to watch a part or Download to save the file you need.

chapters.title: Check actual attendance
chapters.text: Attendance shows participants and their time in the meeting. A scheduled appointment alone does not confirm attendance.

chapters.title: Find the transcript and analysis
chapters.text: Open Transcript to access published transcript evidence and available analysis tools. Availability depends on the meeting type and saved evidence.

chapters.title: Review teaching and coaching quality
chapters.text: Quality check lets you start a review for a learner and find saved checks. Close the meeting details when you are ready to return to the calendar.
